Name: cavalab ECG survival benchmark, ResNet DeepSurv (CODE-15, no demographics)
Summary: Cox log-risk of all-cause death from a 12-lead ECG.

Model properties.Input: 12-lead, 400 Hz, middle 7 s, per-lead z-score with stored statistics, padded to 4096

x-mival.notes: Higher output = higher hazard (Cox log-risk). No baseline hazard is shipped, so only discrimination is evaluated. Input unit mV (gain 1): CODE tracings are mV, established on Lima ECG-age (same corpus) where x1 gives MAE 9.5 y and x10 a 12-year bias; on 1,000 MIMIC sample ECGs (34 deaths) this model's C-index was 0.82 at x1 and 0.79 at x10, too few events to separate. Stored per-lead NM/NS (nchW) are applied in the wrapper, then 648 zeros each side. Lead order is CODE-15 standard (I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF); the benchmark's aVL/aVF swap applies to its own MIMIC h5, not to named leads. Code GPL-3.0, weights CC-BY-4.0.
